note: sidebar icon-button navigation panels -- renders: fixed nav controls (Home, Search, Directory, Administration, etc.) and rooms-list toolbar buttons (sort, create); closed operator vocabulary
rooms-list topbar -- renders: fixed section title (e.g. Omnichannel) and toolbar action buttons; operator vocabulary
sidebar section headers -- renders: fixed category labels (Channels, Direct Messages); closed operator vocabulary
sidebar footer -- renders: fixed footer link/logo; operator vocabulary
sidebar promotional/info link below footer -- renders: fixed platform marketing text (e.g. upgrade/create-workspace); operator vocabulary
main content page frame -- renders: page title heading, action link, section headings; the grid wrapper holding label/value/button rows is subtracted (values may be non-operator-derived)
grid action-button groups -- renders: fixed action buttons (Edit, Change, Configure, etc.); closed operator vocabulary
sidebar item options menu buttons -- fixed operator control inside user-named navigation items
